notes: Body-change counts are javap bodies with column whitespace collapsed, keyed by method signature (tools/source_pins/rebaseline.py changed). The phase-5 counts of 2026-10-18 were not whitespace-normalised: PositionCache showed 40 changed of 53 common methods, and 17 of 54 after normalisation (the 54 include <clinit>).

Verified means the audit's source claims were read against the 0.7.2 bytecode or bridge code, not that the script's hash was recorded. verified_claims and caveats name the evidence; confirmed_on_072 lists what was read on a fail-closed audit.

Several phase-5 'removed' entries were signature changes: ExplosionUtils.performExplosion (Rotation3f added), WorldUtil.getPackedMaterialAndFluidAtPosition and findFluidBlock (ChunkStore parameter). BlockHarvestUtils.performBlockDamage has three overloads on 0.7.2 and Rotation.add keeps its instance overload.

Gate hazard, not a 0.7.2 finding: the crafting audit reads APPDATA in its argparse default, and the gate sets neither APPDATA nor HYTALE_ASSETS_ZIP, so on macOS the crafting audit raises under the gate once the earlier audits pass (the observe tool sets a placeholder APPDATA).

2026-10-18 lane audits_classify: claim-level classification in open_gaps (B, C) and confirmed_on_072 (A). The four analysis agents for perception/entity_geometry, actor_world_state/locomotion, navigation/crafting and mutable_blocks stopped on the weekly API limit (resets 2026-10-23); their unfinished leaves are C by top-level key, and navigation's file was written before the stop.
